body:
## Summary

These are over-redaction and quality problems found while re-checking #15–#23 on main @ c9714cb. None of them leak data, but they damage published sessions and conflict with #1 (public people should not be treated as personal data) and #5 (ordinary uppercase words after "booking" are negatives).

### 1. Public figures handled inconsistently

| Input | Result |
|---|---|
| `Linus Torvalds`, `Elon Musk tweeted`, `Bill Gates`, `Nelson Mandela`, `Satya Nadella`, `Tim Cook`, `Grace Hopper` | kept |
| `Sergey Brin founded Google` | `[REDACTED] founded Google` |
| `Pavel Durov said` | `[REDACTED] said` |
| `Vladimir Putin` | `[REDACTED]` |

The result appears to depend on whether the first name is in the (Slavic) gazetteer, not on whether the person is public. Expected: the bundled public-entity catalog (or `createWikidataVerifier`) takes precedence over the gazetteer for well-known public figures regardless of the name's origin. Add these as fixtures.

### 2. Uppercase words and places taken as identifiers or names

| Input | Result |
|---|---|
| `Booking FAILED today` | `Booking [REDACTED] today` (`BOOKING_REFERENCE`) |
| `reservation HTTP 500` | `reservation [REDACTED] 500` |
| `Marina Bay Sands hotel` | `[REDACTED] Sands hotel` (`PERSON`) |

Expected: booking references must contain at least one digit or match a PNR shape that is not a dictionary word. Add negatives for common uppercase log words (`FAILED`, `ERROR`, `HTTP`, `PENDING`, `OK`, `CANCELLED`, `CONFIRMED`). A first name directly followed by a known place/brand word (`Bay`, `Sands`, `Hotel`, `Street`) should not become a person on its own.

### 3. Fake mode: phones not in a plausible or reserved range (#22)

`mode: 'fake'` turns `phone +7 912 555-01-42` into `+7 227 479-47-38`. The country code and length are kept, but `227` is not a Russian mobile range, and #22 asked to prefer reserved fictional ranges where available. Expected: keep the number type (mobile stays `9xx` for RU) and use reserved/fictional ranges where they exist (NANP 555-01xx, Ofcom drama ranges, …).

The faked MRZ, dates, SNILS, names and emails were verified to be valid, deterministic per key and different across keys. Credentials stay fully redacted.
title: Over-redaction: inconsistent public figures, uppercase words as booking refs, implausible fake phones
